def oracle(input):
    n = input[0]
    a = input[1]
    arr = list(a)
    sorted_arr = sorted(arr)
    pos = {}
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        v = arr[i]
        if v in pos:
            pos[v].append(i)
        else:
            pos[v] = [i]
        i += 1
    target = [0] * n
    used = {}
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        v = sorted_arr[i]
        c = used.get(v, 0)
        target[pos[v][c]] = i
        used[v] = c + 1
        i += 1
    vis = [False] * n
    ops = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if (not vis[i]) and target[i] != i:
            cyc = []
            x = i
            while not vis[x]:
                vis[x] = True
                cyc.append(x)
                x = target[x]
            m = len(cyc)
            j = 1
            while j < m:
                ops.append([cyc[0], cyc[j]])
                j += 1
        i += 1
    return ops
